prompt_en: Vertical medium-close documentary photograph in a quiet afternoon cafe. One explicitly adult original feline beastkin barista wears a covered practical apron and performs a careful latte pour. Her baseline is a steady practiced pour, eyes fixed on the cup and wrist relaxed. A small metal timer chirps beside the espresso machine. The white latte cup beneath the milk stream is the target. Both living cat ears snap toward the timer before her eyes move; her reflective pupils shift sideways, her pouring wrist freezes, and her lips press into a serious line as she tries to keep composure. She resumes the pour a beat late, leaving one tiny off-center curl in an otherwise clean foam rosette. Her adult human face, covered barista apron, organic ear roots, subtle skin-to-fur boundary at the hairline and wrist, and natural pad-claw-nail transition remain readable. Her face, ears, pouring hand, chirping timer, and latte cup share one tight focal plane. Soft window light and cafe color bounce catch the steam, fine fur, cup rim, and creased apron; 50mm natural perspective, foreground saucer blur, gentle focus falloff, and realistic contact shadows. Nonsexual everyday observation, no costume-headband look.
